correctness.rationale: The exact fourth moment has factor \(q^{-5}\), the anisotropic norm shells have sizes \(1\) and \(q+1\), and every nonzero displacement gives exactly \(q\) solutions to the quadratic-shell pair constraint. These identities yield exact Taylor contributions \(q(4q-6)H(r)\) and \(q(4q-2)H(s)\). Subtracting from the norm Taylor coefficient proves the two bands; constant-scalar homogeneity supplies the full two-dimensional kernel. The packaged checker confirms the integer identities at field orders 3, 7, 11, 27, including a non-prime field. No finite test is treated as a proof over every field.
